command:
set -e; echo '=== WORKSPACE ==='; pwd; find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 -type d -printf '%p
' | sort | sed -n '1,220p'; echo '=== GIT ROOTS ==='; find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type d -name .git -printf '%h
' | sort | sed -n '1,160p'; echo '=== CRUSH NAMES ==='; find /workspace -maxdepth 4 -iname '*crush*' -printf '%p
' | sort | sed -n '1,160p'; echo '=== OMEGA NAMES ==='; find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -iname '*omega*' -printf '%p
' | sort | sed -n '1,160p'
